content: Open Food Facts API (official docs): base world.openfoodfacts.org; product by barcode GET /api/v3/product/{barcode}.json (v2 deprecated); search: /api/v2/search or legacy /cgi/search.pl; no server-side full-text in v3 - Search-a-licious at search.openfoodfacts.org; rate limits 15 req/min/IP product reads, 10 req/min/IP search (503 on exceed); User-Agent required as AppName/Version (contact@email); for few hundred+ products prefer bulk exports over API; caching lookups client-side recommended.
